System brightness needs \"Modify system settings\" for Dimmer. While dimming, Dimmer then turns auto-brightness off and lowers the system brightness; both go back to how they were when dimming ends. Until then Dimmer dims with the overlay only.

System brightness: while dimming, Dimmer turns auto-brightness off and lowers the system brightness. When dimming ends, both go back to how they were, unless you changed them yourself in the meantime.

Two strong shakes within a second turn dimming off. Works while the dimming layer is showing and the screen is on, also on the lock screen. Keep this on: at the darkest settings the screen shows nothing and shaking is the one exit you can do without seeing.
Allow other apps to control Dimmer

For Tasker and similar apps: send a broadcast with package com.plainapps.dimmer and action com.plainapps.dimmer.action. plus ON, OFF, TOGGLE, PAUSE (extra minutes), RESUME, DARKER or LIGHTER (extra step), SET (extras darkness, tint, strength; changes the look only), PRESET (extra name) or NEXT_PRESET. While this is on, any installed app can switch the dimmer. For one minute after you turn dimming off yourself, other apps cannot turn it on again or change the look, and DARKER never goes past the darkness you chose.
Power button and presets for Dimmer
Add Quick Settings tile: Dim presets
The tile switches dimming on and off. The presets tile steps through the presets marked \"Include in tile cycle\" and then turns off. Long-press a preset on the home screen to pin it as a shortcut.

Dimmer uses Android\'s Accessibility service for one job: it draws the dark, tinted dimming layer above every screen, including the status bar and the notification shade. That is how it can make the screen darker than your system brightness allows, and why it keeps working when you switch apps.

• Shows the dimming layer and, if you leave \"Lower the screen backlight too\" on, lowers the screen brightness while dimming is on.\n• Shake to turn off (on by default, can be switched off): reads the phone\'s motion sensor while the dimming layer is showing. Room light (only if you switch it on): reads the light sensor while dimming is on. Sensor readings never leave the app.

• It never reads what is on your screen: no text, no apps, no passwords, no messages.\n• It never watches what you type or tap, and never taps or types for you.\n• It never collects or shares any data. Your settings stay on this phone. Dimmer has no accounts, no analytics and no internet permission.

Android shows its own general warning next; it describes every accessibility service in the same words. Dimmer\'s service is set up so it cannot read screen content. You can turn access off in Settings at any time.
On the next screen, turn on \"Use Dimmer\".
If Android says \"Restricted setting\": open App info, tap the three dots, choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
Dimmer\'s Accessibility access stopped, so your screen is back to normal brightness. Tap to turn it on again.

Only while dimming is on. In a very dark room (under 3 lux for 10 seconds) Dimmer switches to the dark-room preset. In a bright room (over 150 lux for 10 seconds) it suspends the overlay and gives your backlight back, until the room gets under 80 lux. In between it shows your chosen look.
That preset was deleted. Dimmer keeps your chosen look in a dark room.
This phone has no light sensor, so this does nothing.

Modify system settings: not allowed (not needed by the current backlight method)
Notifications: blocked. The dimming notification and the \"Dimmer stopped\" notice cannot show.
If the screen ever stays too dark

• Shake the phone twice. Shake to turn off is on by default and works on the lock screen too.
• Or, in the Dimmer notification, tap Pause, then Off. The Dimmer tile and widget turn it off as well.
• Or restart the phone. If "Resume after restart" is on and the schedule is running, dimming comes back after the restart: restart, then shake the phone twice.
• Last resort: start the phone in Safe mode. It switches off every accessibility app, Dimmer included.
Dimmer collects no data and has no internet permission. Your settings stay on this phone.
